desktop.notes: Fixed live channel stream playback, resolved native player build error with automatic fallback to inbuilt player, enabled robust in-memory TS streaming with direct proxy fallback, and added CORS headers.

android.notes: Resolved Dolby Atmos and TNT Ultimate playback freeze on Android TV with 250ms passthrough buffer and new PCM Stereo compatibility mode in Player Settings; eliminated Sports Guide navigation sluggishness and crashes by streamlining channel matching and request cancellation.
